GRCh38.note: approximate; co-duplicates IGHG4/IGHG2/IGHA1/IGHE within ~120 kb block

discriminating_snps.source: DNA-Architecture 104-sample sweep — 14/15 NAHR-block-haps show canonical-pattern at this position

diagnostic_features.snp_density_note: Unlike Tandem-Small (which is 100 % chimdup-PSV), NAHR-block carriers are 14/15 canonical-PSV. This is a mechanistically distinct CNV class — the ~120 kb block likely arose from independent NAHR between IGHG paralog flanks, not from gene-conversion of an already-chimdup tandem-dup.

promoter_signature.note: 14/15 NAHR-block carriers show canonical motif on both IGHG4 copies (= the dup is canonical-canonical, not chimeric)

switch_region.name: Sgamma4
switch_region.note: Sγ4 between the two NAHR-block copies has 84.8 % identity with 14.8 % gaps (HG00290 hap2 G048887 vs G048898 evidence), much lower than Tandem-Small (99.99 %). This is structural evidence that the two CNV classes formed by different mechanisms.

primary.note: Mapper must detect block-spanning chains: a NAHR-block carrier shows ~120 kb of synteny between the two copies. Tandem-Small shows ~19.5 kb. Distinguishing the two classes requires long-read or assembly-context spanning the block boundary.

fallback_chain.name: relaxed_mismatch
fallback_chain.rationale: NAHR-block has gaps that break primary chains

fallback_chain.name: chain_only
fallback_chain.trigger: extension diverges in inter-copy gap region

fallback_chain.name: block_span_check
fallback_chain.trigger: verify both copies of co-dup partners (G2/A1/E) are present
fallback_chain.rationale: distinguishes NAHR-block (4-gene co-dup) from incidental Tandem-Small near other IG genes

test_cases.note: 1 of 15 NAHR-block haps with mixed PSV signature — possible gene-conversion between NAHR-block and chimdup haplotype

primary_sources.note: DNA-Architecture-Test across 104 HPRC R2 samples (208 haps), 15/208 = 7.2 % NAHR-block-class identified

supporting_databases: HPRC R2 pangenome (Liao 2023 + 2026 update) — primary evidence
